articles.title: Barclays to cut about 200 investment banking jobs in New York and London - report
articles.summary: Investing.com -- Barclays PLC (NYSE:BCS) is preparing to eliminate approximately 200 positions across its investment banking division, extending a broader restructuring push aimed at curbing expenses and sharpening operational efficiency.
